schema.name: ask_user_question

questions.description: Array of questions to ask the user. Each question has its own set of options.

items.description: A single question with its options.

question.description: The complete question to ask the user. Should be clear, specific, and end with a question mark.

options.description: Array of options for the user to choose from

items.description: A single option within a question.

label.description: The display text for this option that the user will see and select. Should be concise (1-5 words) and clearly describe the choice.

description.description: Explanation of what this option means or what will happen if chosen. Useful for providing context about trade-offs or implications.

preview.description: Optional preview content rendered when this option is focused. Use for mockups, code snippets, or visual comparisons that help users compare options. Only supported for single-select questions.

multi_select.description: If true, the user can select multiple options. Default is false (single select).

schema.description:
Ask the user a question and present options.

Usage notes:
- Users will always be able to select "Other" to provide custom text input
- If you recommend a specific option, make that the first option in the list and add "(Recommended)" at the end of the label
